verdict.rationale: The docs describe a 'Pay' category with account verification, balance checks, ACH detail retrieval, account validation and payment-success prediction, but none of these evidence items describe an actual API call that initiates or moves a bank payment (i.e., pay-by-bank execution), and there is no statement of live geographies for any payment-initiation capability. This looks like decisioning/verification support for payments rather than payment initiation itself.
